show.description: In the blood-soaked lands of Haryana, Abhimanyu Dahiya watches his father fall to the ruthless Sangwan clan and swears revenge. Years later, he returns in vengeance, destroying everything in his path… until fate binds him to Meher, his enemy’s daughter, in a marriage built on hatred. But when Abhimanyu discovers Meher is the very girl who once saved his life, his world shatters. Torn between his father’s blood and his own heart, he must choose - vengeance… or redemption. Watch Now!
